protocol.baseline: Current uncommitted climate-adjusted estimator, frozen before the wind/trend experiment.
protocol.holdout: Remove the target ID from current temperature/wind, both history frames and historical normal catalogue. Regional folds 0 and 3 excluded from fitting and calibration candidate ranking.
protocol.folds: (floor(latitude*3)*3+floor(longitude*2)*5)%7; fold 3 includes the publicly diagnosed large-error region and is reserved.
protocol.features: Only observed temperature, observed wind and static terrain/land use plus solar geometry. No sunshine/estimated weather, JMA estimated temperature, or NWP products.
protocol.candidates: Legacy bounded reweighting; advected previous observations with regional observed warming; ridge residual models with wind-only, trend-only or joint interactions, bounded correction.
protocol.acceptance: Lower pooled MAE and RMSE; no pooled, morning, coastal, >=800m, outside-hull or reserved-region p95/max increase. No per-frame MAE or RMSE increase. Missing and fallback cases retain the same coverage. Coefficients locked before acquiring evaluation data.
protocol.limits: Only two late-autumn days. History represents a warm app session. Own-history and known-target wind upper-bound diagnostics never count as deployable accuracy.

specifiedBeforeEvaluation.calm: Direction code 0 and speed <=0.2m/s retain speed without assigning a bearing; zero speed has no direction.
specifiedBeforeEvaluation.shortHistory: Distinct 20-40 minute and exact 60-minute history required.
specifiedBeforeEvaluation.models: Static/solar control, wind only, trend only and joint interactions; 3 blocked time folds; ridge 0.1/1, strength 0.5/1, all/morning gates.
specifiedBeforeEvaluation.bounds: Residual correction capped at +/-1C; advection/trend primitives at +/-2C before blending/cap.
specifiedBeforeEvaluation.modelFit: Training residual winsorized at +/-3C; feature scaling fitted only on training folds; standardized feature magnitude capped at 5.
specifiedBeforeEvaluation.diagnosticEvaluation: No calibration candidate passed all gates. Evaluation is diagnostic; do not activate on the basis of its average alone.

limits: Approximately two late-autumn days, not multi-season evidence.
The target current temperature/wind, historical temperature/wind and own historical normals are all removed.
Other contemporaneous public neighboring observations remain available.
Station altitude substitutes for target DEM; warmed-session history assumed.
